models.name: econ_pol_discussion_board_guests
models.description:
Guests of the econPolDiscussionBoard system who may browse content without authentication.

This entity represents unauthenticated visitors with minimal data stored for tracking and basic audit purposes. Guests do not log in and have limited access rights.

plainFields.name: username
plainFields.description: Username chosen by the guest user for identification during visits.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this guest record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the guest record.

models.name: econ_pol_discussion_board_guest_sessions
models.description:
Session records for guest users tracking individual browsing sessions.

Each session links to exactly one guest and records connection metadata such as IP address, referrer, and timestamps.
Sessions enable audit of guest activity without requiring login credentials.

foreignFields.name: econ_pol_discussion_board_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the guest who owns this session. {@link econ_pol_discussion_board_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest during the session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL accessed during the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired, if applicable.

models.name: econ_pol_discussion_board_members
models.description:
Members with authenticated accounts on econPolDiscussionBoard who can post articles, comment, and upload attachments.

Holds securely hashed password and essential data to control identity and authentication.

plainFields.name: username
plainFields.description: Unique user name chosen by the member.

plainFields.name: password_hash

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address for member communication and login identification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this member record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp if the member account is deactivated.

models.name: econ_pol_discussion_board_articles
models.description:
Articles posted by members on the econPolDiscussionBoard.

This table stores plain-text articles created by authenticated members. Each article includes an author reference to the member who created it, ensuring accountability and traceability. Articles are timestamped upon creation and update to support audit trails and order listings by recency.

Attachments are stored separately in the attachments table to avoid nullable fields and maintain normalization. This design supports multiple attachments per article, enriching content with images or documents.

foreignFields.name: econ_pol_discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member who authored the article. {@link econ_pol_discussion_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the article, summarizing its content.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Plain-text content body of the article.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was last updated.

models.name: econ_pol_discussion_board_attachments
models.description:
Attachments associated with articles on the econPolDiscussionBoard.

This table stores metadata for files and images attached to articles. Each attachment links to a single article and includes detailed information such as type (image or file), URL location, original filename, and upload timestamp.

Attachments enhance articles by allowing multimedia content and document references, supporting the core value proposition of rich content in a focused discussion board. Attachments are non-editable and depend on their parent article lifecycle.

foreignFields.name: econ_pol_discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent article. {@link econ_pol_discussion_board_articles.id}.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Type of attachment, either 'image' or 'file'.

plainFields.name: url
plainFields.description: URL location where the attachment file is stored.

plainFields.name: file_name
plainFields.description: Original filename of the attachment.

plainFields.name: uploaded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was uploaded.

models.name: econ_pol_discussion_board_comments
models.description:
Comments posted by members on economic and political discussion board articles.

Each comment is associated with a specific article and authored by a registered member. Comments support nesting by allowing a parent comment reference for up to two levels of replies.

The comments table tracks creation and update timestamps for audit and moderation purposes. Comments are designed for minimal complexity, enabling straightforward querying and management within the discussion board.

foreignFields.name: econ_pol_discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the article that this comment belongs to. {@link econ_pol_discussion_board_articles.id}.

foreignFields.name: econ_pol_discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Author of the comment, a registered member. {@link econ_pol_discussion_board_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: parent_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the parent comment for nested replies, allowing up to two levels of nesting within the discussion board. {@link econ_pol_discussion_board_comments.id}.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Plain text content of the comment. Limited to 500 characters as per business requirements.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was last updated.
